units.source_text: 善巧太子，别本作善瞿夷太子。

en.t: Prince Shanko is called Prince Zengu'i in another version.

units.source_text: 据旧注：善巧太子是释迦的儿子罗睺罗尊者的别名，释迦出家后六年始生此子。

en.t: According to the old commentary, Prince Shanko was another name for the venerable Rahula, the son of Shakyamuni; this child was born only six years after Shakyamuni left home to become a monk.

units.source_text: 但他没有人教，自己悟得是释迦之子。

en.t: But without anyone teaching him, he realized on his own that he was Shakyamuni's son.
